subject: english
title: Present Continuous
description: Actions in progress, temporary situations, and the verbs that refuse the -ing form.

content.title: When to use it
content.body: Present Continuous covers what is happening now, what is temporary, and arrangements already fixed for the near future: I'm working from home this week. We're meeting the client on Thursday.

content.title: Form
content.body: am / is / are + verb-ing. The auxiliary agrees with the subject and carries the negative and the question: Is she working? She isn't working.

content.title: Watch out
content.body: State verbs (know, understand, own, prefer) normally have no continuous form. "I'm loving it" is deliberate marketing, not a model sentence.

exercises.question: Complete the sentence.

answers.text: slept
is sleeping
sleeps
has slept

exercises.explanation: The action is in progress at the moment of speaking, which is the core use of Present Continuous.

exercises.question: Which sentence is correct?

answers.text: I take usually the bus, but this week I cycling.
I am usually taking the bus, but this week I cycle.
I usually take the bus, but this week I'm cycling.
I usually am taking the bus, but this week I'm cycle.

exercises.explanation: The habit takes Present Simple and the temporary change takes Present Continuous. That contrast is exactly what the two tenses are for.

exercises.question: "I am knowing the answer" is correct English.
exercises.explanation: Know is a state verb and takes the simple form: I know the answer.

exercises.question: Translate the sentence.
exercises.sentence: W tym tygodniu pracuję z domu.

answers.text: I work from home this week.
I'm working from home this week.
I have worked from home this week.
I worked from home this week.

exercises.explanation: "W tym tygodniu" marks a temporary arrangement, so English prefers the continuous form.

exercises.question: Complete the sentence.
exercises.sentence: They are ___ a new office in Wrocław.

answers.text: opening
opens
opend
openning

exercises.explanation: The consonant is only doubled when the final syllable is stressed: run → running, but open → opening.

exercises.question: Why is "We're meeting the client on Thursday" acceptable for a future event?

answers.text: Present Continuous expresses arrangements that are already fixed
Because Thursday is close to the present
Because meet has no future form
It is not acceptable — it needs will

exercises.explanation: A definite arrangement, usually with another person and a time, takes the continuous form. Predictions and offers take will.

exercises.question: Which negative is correct?

answers.text: She not listening.
She don't listening.
She doesn't listening.
She isn't listening.

exercises.explanation: The auxiliary be carries the negative in continuous tenses; do and does belong to the simple forms.

exercises.question: Vocabulary
exercises.back: always + continuous expresses irritation about a repeated habit
exercises.explanation: The simple form would be neutral. With the continuous, the speaker is complaining.

exercises.question: Complete the sentence.
exercises.sentence: The number of remote jobs ___ every year.

answers.text: has grown once
grew
is growing
grow

exercises.explanation: Trends and changing situations take the continuous form: prices are rising, the climate is warming.

exercises.question: Complete the question.
exercises.sentence: ___ they still working on the release?

answers.text: Are
Do
Have
Does

exercises.explanation: Continuous questions are formed with the verb to be, which moves in front of the subject.

exercises.question: Which sentence describes a fixed plan rather than a prediction?

answers.text: I think it will rain tomorrow.
I am meeting the client at ten tomorrow.
It is going to be a long week.
I will call you tomorrow.

exercises.explanation: Present Continuous with a time expression signals something already arranged with someone else. will is for decisions made at the moment of speaking.

exercises.question: Translate the sentence.

answers.text: I review your pull request right now.
I have reviewed your pull request.
I am reviewing your pull request right now.
I was reviewing your pull request.

exercises.explanation: An action in progress at the moment of speaking is the core use of Present Continuous.

exercises.question: The -ing form of "make" is "makeing".
exercises.explanation: A silent final e is dropped: make → making, write → writing. It is kept in see → seeing and agree → agreeing.

exercises.question: "I'm seeing the doctor at four" is correct, but "I'm seeing what you mean" is not. Why?

answers.text: The first is an arrangement (an activity); the second is perception, which is stative
See can never take a time expression
The second needs the past tense
Both are actually correct

exercises.explanation: Several verbs have an activity sense and a state sense, and only the activity one takes the continuous. I see what you mean.

exercises.question: Vocabulary
exercises.back: running · sitting · beginning · preferring — doubled when the last syllable is stressed
exercises.explanation: Compare open → opening and offer → offering, where the stress is on the first syllable.
